All dynamic verification steps (csim, cosim) failed due to linker errors finding '_compare_token', indicating either the function was not properly defined/exported or there is a name mangling issue between C and C++ compilation units.

Synthesis failed because bambu command was not found, suggesting the test environment is not properly configured with the PandA-Bambu toolchain. This is an infrastructure issue, not an implementation defect.
